scope: Six outer Canvas renewal acceptance owners and three owned container children, not the complete Canvas target or authority to skip tests. Component ownership is lexical source evidence, not execution proof or complete transitive input closure.

fast_owner.proves: Four service-composition scenarios cross anoncrypt/authcrypt and private-address allow/refuse using the production endpoint validator and DIDComm envelope, with fake repository, builder, lifecycle and recording transport ports.
fast_owner.does_not_prove: Real PostgreSQL, Redis, configured ingress, an external process, actual HTTPS wallet delivery, image/container cleanup, or durable issued rows and ciphertext.

assertions: Four exact authcrypt/anoncrypt × private-address allow/refuse rendered combinations
Native DIDComm private-IP, TLS CA, encryption policy and DID-web peer fields; Gateway issuance and Redis endpoints
runtime_prerequisites: Python fixture renderer and configured Compose binary
component_owners.does_not_prove: Rendered configuration is not real TLS, DIDComm encryption, PostgreSQL, ingress, wallet delivery, packaged-process or container cleanup evidence.

assertions: Four exact authcrypt/anoncrypt x private-address allow/refuse resolved Kubernetes combinations after one real envsubst preparation
Native DIDComm private-IP, TLS CA, encryption policy and DID-web peer fields; Gateway issuance and Redis endpoints
runtime_prerequisites: envsubst and the closed synthetic Kubernetes spec
component_owners.does_not_prove: Resolved configuration is not a deployed Kubernetes process, real TLS, DIDComm encryption, PostgreSQL, ingress or wallet delivery. On Windows the test is discoverable but returns before rendering.

assertions: Both configured authcrypt and anoncrypt variants refuse a private DIDComm endpoint before builder allocation or transport
Real PostgreSQL successor stays pending with pre-send links, no issued credential, delivery or event rows, unchanged source, and absent transport claim
runtime_prerequisites: Synthetic source DID and generated policy file
component_owners.does_not_prove: Refusal occurs before either encryption branch; this does not execute authcrypt or anoncrypt cryptography, an application process, peer server, HTTPS wallet transport, rendered ingress or deployment configuration.

profiles.retained: Linux owned-container Gateway ingress, rendered config, PostgreSQL and Redis, wallet capture, persisted credential/delivery/events, refusal with no legacy fallback, and cleanup.

Resolved Kubernetes native direct configuration, owned PostgreSQL and Redis, real packaged process, wallet capture, durable rows, and cleanup.
Rendered native configuration, owned PostgreSQL and Redis, packaged process, wallet capture, durable rows, and cleanup.
